title: On demand reading BG - feature request
symptom: Users request an 'on demand' reading button to get a BG value in between the regular 5 minute intervals, especially after being out of range or when needing a reading sooner.
cause: The five minute interval is due to the Dexcom transmitter sleeping for five minutes before waking up and sending the BG. While the transmitter is sleeping, all connectivity is turned off and won't be available until the interval is over.
fix: No fix is possible; the feature cannot be implemented because the 5-minute broadcast interval is due to the BLE programming on the Dexcom transmitter and cannot be changed.
